notes.title: Update 2.0.0
notes.notes:
Just another quick update and implementations for unBorn!!



 Fixed skipping method with scoring, previous  formula used incorrect scorring

 Fixed bug where speed power ups did not spawn

 Fixed bug where trying to skip past the very end dialogue scene via the right and left mouse button would crash the game

 Implemented some new level designs:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32391163/549ccffd6bfc640a26e381b2f14b86f12f79c595.png https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32391163/e4b2fee1ebab209c218b509b96d310fe5f686662.pngChanged 2 levels from each chapter to be infection levels, where you are instead devouring certain juvenile viruses.

 Updated some enemy sound effects

 New scoring method on win screen is automatic and goes to the chapter level after winning in 2.2 seconds to better streamline levels

 Updated gold sperm and power ups so the spawn more often, decreasing level time

 The goal is to make level to level progression happen more quickly - unBorn should only take 1-2 hours to finish, and shouldn't be taking as long as some have reported. It should be light and fun!! 

Feed back is always appreciated!!

Thank you!

would still play ( thank you steam user EvictionNotice )

notes.title: Update 1.0.De
notes.notes:
Thanks to steam user EvictionNotice, we had some great feedback and helped us fix some dire issues!!

• Fixed the first achievement, "Taking the first swim" - removed the option of skipping part of the opening cinematic by clicking the ovum in the main menu

•Updated the mapping system and shooting system to be all mouse oriented 

•Fixed the final cinematic sequence where you would only see a black screen instead of the dialogue and story line

• Fixed the monocyte bestiary infomatic

notes.title: Update 1.0.A
notes.notes:
unBorn is released!! Yah!

 Following that, there has been just a few tweaks:



 Updated current build, it appears developers tools was bundled with the original game.

fixed ambient lighting

updated scoring system, previously the percentage for the score would make each level take a lot longer time to complete than it should have

 updated boss hp, thanks  to user feedback

 Typos and missing levels fixed - thanks to all our beta testers!!



Our next goal is to get different OS systems out and to work on multiple language support!! Hope everyone is enjoying unBorn!!

notes.title: Update as of 4/20/218
notes.notes:
unBorn is almost complete!

A lot for unBorn has been completed in the last couple of weeks:


All steam achievements have been tested and initiallized

Bestiary has been completed

U.I. touch ups have been completed


 However we still have some things left to complete, and because of that I am pushing the release date to 04/30/2018 at the very latest - more than likely it will be released before then once the following has been completed:


Final music for last 3 bosses and chapters music background

betatesting for the length of time that each level takes -  so we can get just the right amount so that each level is never too short or too long




After  unBorn officially launches we will begin multiple language localization:


Russian

Chinese

Portuguese (Brasil)

German 

 Potentially Spanish (SA localizations if interest is show)

                               Thank you for supporting unBorn!
